data.name: Dhiru
data.gender_notes: Dhiru is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dhiru is derived from the Sanskrit word 'dhirah' which means 'intention, attention, focus'. It is a name given to those who are wise and focused in their actions and thoughts. The name Dhiru carries the meaning “Intention, Attention, Focus” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dhiru usually hope their child will grow to embody intention, attention, focus and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be steadfast in one's purpose and focused on the divine.
data.etymology: Dhiru belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intention, Attention, Focus.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhiru total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

It is a reminder of the importance of mindfulness in everyday life, and is often given to children to encourage them to develop these qualities from a young age.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Dhiru represents the inner voice of consciousness and the pursuit of knowledge and truth. It speaks to the individual's innate capacity for growth and self-discovery, as well as their potential for spiritual awakening and enlightenment. By embodying the qualities of focus and attention, the name Dhiru serves as a reminder to stay present and aware in the face of life's challenges and to always strive for wisdom and inner peace.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Dhiru symbolizes deep thought and focused determination. Thus, Dhiru represents an individual who thinks deeply and acts with firm resolve.
